description: Enhanced ignore-pattern cases: a literal pattern that ignores one exact word while another misspelling is flagged, an anchored pattern matching letters-then-digits tokens, and a digit-run pattern that ignores an alphanumeric token while a plain misspelling is still flagged. Each reported misspelling is its UTF-8 start byte offset, end byte offset, and text, one per line, ordered by position. The request is {"op":"spellcheck","text":<text>,"lang":"text","ignore_patterns":[regexes...]}.
